How GymPal Health uses your data

GymPal Health reads two things from Health Connect: your step count and your sleep sessions. It adds them up into one total per day and sends only those daily totals to the GymPal server you linked, over HTTPS. It never reads other health data, never writes to Health Connect, and never shares your data with anyone else. GymPal uses the totals to show your steps and sleep, to raise your calorie target on busier days, to suggest a lighter workout after a short night, and to let the AI coach answer questions about them. Unlinking the phone in GymPal stops it sending anything more.
